zh-Hans:
333 更新重点：
改善会议录音、转写提示与布局；回放增加拖动时间轴、前后跳转和播放／暂停，并调整语音输入中断处理。
改进计划与目标衔接，支持编辑、暂停、继续和删除目标。暂停或删除只影响后续自动推进，当前这轮工作继续；输入框的停止会停止本轮并暂停对应目标，同轮继续不会自动重新开启长期目标。
记忆列表区分已保留与实际使用；浏览不再续期，已删除任务的旧信息逐步淡化与归档，保护固定内容、长期偏好和当前引用。
完善二维 CAD、地图、原理图／PCB 助手，加入三维元件库；二维图纸隐藏三维草图提示栏。整理图片菜单与小屏参数，区分文字新建／更新，助手支持编辑历史、撤销与重做。
改善生物素材与结果显示、化学／生物计算环境使用、Office 公式结果和 Word 标题转换，以及模型工具请求和任务恢复提示。
模型设置增加“不发送思考参数”开关；按实际能力适配思考强度，保留模型的思考与工具结果。完善长文档原生分段读写和校验保存，预览不可用时保留准确的保存回执。
Mac Bridge 可按授权读取其它工作区的指定文件和图片；帮助按平台整理，普通 PDF 手记移除 LaTeX 入口，保留 Duo 展开布局与草稿连续性。
请重点反馈录音回放、目标控制、旧记忆保留、编辑器助手结果与撤销，以及 Office、Bridge 和 Duo 的实际使用。
en-US:
Build 333 update:
Refines meeting recording, transcription messages and layout. Playback adds a draggable timeline, skip controls and play/pause, with improved voice-input interruption handling.
Improves plan-to-goal transitions and goal editing, pause, resume and delete. Pausing or deleting a goal stops future automatic progress while the current round continues. Stop beside the message box stops the round and pauses its goal; continuing the same round does not restart long-term progress.
Memory entries distinguish retention from active use. Browsing no longer renews retention; older information from deleted tasks can fade and be archived while pins, lasting preferences and current references are protected.
Improves 2D CAD, map and schematic/PCB assistants, adds a 3D component library, and hides the 3D sketch bar in standalone 2D. Organizes image menus and compact controls, separates text creation from updates, and adds assistant access to edit history, undo and redo.
Improves biology assets/results, chemistry and biology environment use, Office formula results, Word headings, model tool requests and task-recovery messages.
Adds per-model thinking-parameter omission, capability-based reasoning levels, and more reliable native long-document reads and writes. Saved files retain an accurate receipt if their preview is unavailable.
Mac Bridge can read authorized files and images in other Mac workspaces. Help is organized by platform; ordinary PDF Notes removes the LaTeX entry. Duo's expanded layout and draft continuity are retained.
Please focus feedback on recording/playback, goal controls, old-memory retention, editor results/undo, Office, Bridge and Duo.
